claim: An adversarial self-review found six defects in the work delivered by EVD-0073..EVD-0078, including one that invalidated the headline metric: the strict check count was inflated by duplicate existence checks, so the reported progression 913 -> 946 overstated both endpoints. All six are fixed; the corrected progression is 840 -> 864 distinct checks.
scope: Self-review of the evidence records and code introduced in this branch, plus the pre-existing duplication in verify-eos.js. No new capability. Metric correction, attribution corrections, and two reviewability fixes.
source: Logs from /tmp/baseline-verify.log (main) and the post-change runs; canonical type counts derived by deduplication of the real output
action: Deduplicated REQUIRED_PATHS, corrected two attributions, fixed a wrong path in a failure message, made warnings individually readable, removed dead destructuring, and derived the true check counts from the logs.
expected: 'Checks Passed: 865 | Failures: 0', exit 0, 'Warnings (non-blocking): 2' printed with their individual messages, and 21/21 tests passing.
actual: 'Checks Passed: 864 | Failures: 0' before this record was registered (865 with it), 0 failures, and the two surviving warnings are now printed as individual lines instead of a bare count. Tests 21/21.
risks: Deduplicating lowered the headline number. A lower number from a stricter measure is not a regression, but it must be read against the corrected baseline, not against 913.
limitations: The corrected baseline of 840 is derived by counting duplicate existence checks in the main-branch log (555 existence lines, 482 distinct, 73 duplicates) and subtracting them from 913; it was not re-measured by deduplicating main and re-running.
Duplicate checks in other categories may remain inside individual lock modules; only the shared REQUIRED_PATHS list was deduplicated.
review_findings: D1 METRIC DEFECT (fixed): existence checks were duplicated 73 times on main, so 913 and 946 both overstated their guarantee count. Corrected: 840 -> 864.
D2 ATTRIBUTION (fixed): the $40M DCVC round was credited to SRC-0075, which announces the release but not the round. Now credited to SRC-0077 only.
D3 OVERSTATEMENT (fixed): CMP-0002 called chrome-devtools MCP the 'EOS current' seam; the evidence only shows it as a documented option in docs/openspec-tasks-mandatory-steps.md. Relabelled.
D4 WRONG PATH (fixed): a lock failure reported docs/intelligence/RSC, a directory that does not exist, instead of the offending file.
D5 HIDDEN DEBT (fixed): verify printed only warning counts, so tolerated debt was invisible in CI output. Individual messages are now printed, capped at ten.
D6 DEAD CODE (fixed): an unused destructured binding left over from the title-check refactor.
